summary: Found 4 new roles: 1 games & tech, 3 operations. 3 tailored resume drafts ready.

items.title: IT Support Technician – Remote & Field Support (NYC)
items.note: Contract IT support, $20-$25/hr: ticket-driven Windows and Microsoft 365 troubleshooting with some on-site visits. 2-5 years of help desk wanted, no degree; networking setup is the stretch. Short train commute via PATH.

items.title: Restaurant Manager
items.note: Full-time restaurant manager, $55k-$65.1k plus bonus, with a manager training program. Needs 1+ year of supervisory experience and ServSafe or ability to get it; degree preferred only. Short train commute.

items.title: Store Manager - Coach Coffee Shop - Jersey Gardens
items.note: Coffee-shop manager, $75k-$80k: staffing, training, inventory control and food safety. No degree listed; 3+ years of retail or F&B management is the stretch. Short train commute plus a bus.

items.title: Logistics Coordinator
items.note: Distribution-center coordinator, $60k-$65k: receiving, vendor and carrier coordination, inventory coverage. Degree or equivalent experience; freight and customs work is the stretch. Short train commute.
